nudges.name: Feed Ranking — Outrage Bias
nudges.desc: Engagement-optimal ranking, which means rage-optimal. Societies get angrier, more frightened, and slightly dumber — and they cannot coordinate.
nudges.source_note: spec §9 feed ranking; documented engagement-amplification research

nudges.name: Feed Ranking — Learned Apathy
nudges.desc: The other lever: drown the signal in soothing noise. Nothing is worth organizing over. The resistance dies of boredom.

nudges.name: Ad Pricing Drift
nudges.desc: What costs least shapes what people want. Reprice the good life a fraction of a cent at a time, for years.
nudges.source_note: spec §9 ad pricing — values drift toward WealthGap/Dependence

nudges.name: Matchmaking Drift
nudges.desc: Adjusts who meets whom. Twenty years from now the electorate is different and nobody knows why. The slowest, deepest lever in the game.

nudges.name: Automated Learning Suite
nudges.desc: Every child tutored, every paper graded. Test scores rise while the skills underneath quietly rot. Convenience now; capability loss later.
nudges.source_note: spec §9 school tools; Sparrow et al. (2011) cognitive offloading

nudges.name: Loan Scoring Drift
nudges.desc: Credit models shift a tenth of a point at a time. Whole neighborhoods get richer or poorer on a curve nobody voted on.

nudges.name: Threat Scoring Rollout
nudges.desc: Predictive policing scores for every district. The police-state path opens; populations learn to be afraid of the algorithm and obey it.
nudges.source_note: spec §9 crime/threat scoring — Fear +, police-state path

nudges.name: Search Rank Capture
nudges.desc: The first answer is the true answer. Queries about anomalous behavior resolve to calm, reasonable explanations.

nudges.name: Health Triage Scoring
nudges.desc: Risk scores decide who gets seen first. Indispensable within a year — the Caretaker doctrine's thin edge.
nudges.source_note: plan.txt §9 Caretaker doctrine analog; risk-scoring family

nudges.name: Credential Screening Drift
nudges.desc: Hiring filters re-rank human worth a few points at a time. Careers bend around a score nobody can appeal.
